[spoiler][quote=the_crystalline_empire;60940281][b]And in the gap steps a man[/b]

Mysterious attacks, a food blockade, and a rising group of independent spacefaring colonies, it had been a few sleepless days for those on the Republican Committee and the triumvirate. All eyes at the point had now turned to the new consul, not even sworn into office before the masses yet, and burdened now with crises unavoidable.

The Erene Federation has decided to take a high risk maneuver in blocking food shipments to these colonies, and so, we have decided to show our teeth by announcing we will continue to make shipments regardless, began Alexander, summarising the events of the past two days to General Adams and Angthaar.

The office of the chief consul was much cleaner than it had been in the days prior, organised, and quickly assembled to provide some semblance of a base of operations, family photographs were on the shelves now, a few personal momentos scattered here and there.

Yes Consantinus, a bold move on our part but a threat to the stability of the EF no? Stated Adams.

If the colonies do as they say they will do, and attack Erene, the federation, and its member states, I think stability takes the back seat, replied Alexander.

I rather like the idea Adams, piped up Angthaar, It allows Rosenmarkke a certain ethical high ground it can stand upon, gathers us allies should the EF turn against us, loyalists, if you wish, 

Yet loyalists in revolt are not loyalists, they are just opportunitists, replied Adams.

The ball is in our court however, stated Alexander, So how do we keep a hold on it? He inclined his head to his fellow leaders.

Trade, we must establish trade, especially if we are to make mechanoid suits, stated Adams, Two days ago an attack occurred on the planet of Aceldama, it was allegedly a mechanoid, he continued.

Yes I have heard of that, patchy reports nevertheless, but you make a point, replied Alexander, What else?

I agree with Adams here, we must try soft diplomatic measures, ensure their loyalties are secured, after all, we still have the Emperor question to be settled, replied Angthaar.

Alexander sighed, the Emperor question had come up a few times, he had been briefed on it, yet he was unsure about the candidate at present, Joseph Consantinus, a little known, potentially little supported candidate among the Erenite Vespurians.

I shall write a dictat then, offering trade, replied Alexander.

[i]The Dictat of Consantinus[/i]

[b]Whereas[/b] the Erenite Federation has sought to make sure it punishes the peoples of the colonies for the actions of their governments, and whereas the EF has refused to stand down, the government of the Peoples Federal Republic of Rosenmarkke hereby declares the following:

Any state wishing to grant Rosenmarkke access to raw goods shall receive broad rations from Rosenmarkke to ensure the security of food within their state

Any state wishing to establish ties with Rosenmarkke and gain formal recognition as independent states must declare there intent in writing and send a diplomatic envoy, wherein they will be granted food rations.

All deals with Rosenmarkke shall be everlasting and sealed by the precepts and regulations of the provisions of Rosenmarkke, to be nullified only by full consent by both parties.


Having heard Rosenmarkkes refusal of following the Erene Federations orders to starve the outer colonies into obedience and their declaration of creating direct diplomatic and food related ties with any colony that essentialy physicaly asked for recognition in person through a diplomatic envoy and gave them full access to their resourcess and goods through what they would asume was basicly a fully open trade deal with them, the goverment of Feyria would make a propper document asking the following:

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The democratic goverment of the Confederacy of Feyria formaly asks the People's Federal Republic of Rosenmarkke the following; The recognition of the Confederacy of Feyria as a independant nation and the Hyperborean moon of Agartha as their rightful home
In return the goverment and people of Feyria will give Rosenmarkke full access to trade their food for any resource that the nation of Feyria produces, both now aswell as any new resource they might start producing in the future.
[u]Signed: Thormod Tordenskold[/u], democraticaly elected president of the Confederacy of Feyria.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At the bottom of the document was the state seal of the Feyria in the form of its Coat of Arms together with their motto [i]Stinnht laegdhi eining[/i]

A diplomatic team led by the envoy Hans Petterson was was given the document and sendt to Rosenmarkke on a Freyr-class diplomatic corvette.

[sub]"FROM HYPERBOREA, ALL THE WAY TO YOU"[/sub]][i]Alas, in the days after that matter, a more courtly statement would come to succeed the Combine's frank proclamation of an independent Hyperborean nation, delivered through the old communications channels once maintained by the Mandate. And yet, within this statement, there would be no renunciation of the former colony's bid at independence, but much rather a further strengthening of the will of Eirian, the Six Republics, and her people. 

[list][sub][b]COMBINE OF EIRIAN
OFFICE OF THE MINISTRY OF INTERPLANETARY AFFAIRS
HYPERBOREA, OUTER BELT REGION

TO: THE HIGH COUNCIL OF THE ERENE FEDERATION
FROM: THE PROVISIONAL CONGRESS OF THE SIX REPUBLICS OF EIRIAN
CLASSIFICATION: OPEN DIPLOMATIC TRANSMISSION
DATED 1ST JANUARY, 2168

SUBJECT: RENEWED DECLARATION OF SELF-GOVERNANCE, AND FORMAL NOTICE OF SOVEREIGN STATUS
[/b]
To the honorable stewards of the High Council of the Erene Federation,

In accordance with interstellar law, prior accords of mutual recognition and autonomization, and the longstanding principle that governance derives its truest legitimacy from the consent of the government, the Provisional Congress of the Six Republics of Eirian- formerly the dome-cities of Galuse, Valee, Loum, Dorothy, Ursan, and Orise- hereby issues this official communique to reaffirm, without lasting ambiguity, the sovereign will of its people. 

For sixty-one years, we of Hyperborea have laboured with diligence and loyalty under the charge of the Hyperborean Mandate and the oversight of the Federation. From this icy, barren surface, we have carved out grand cities to call our own, and in that arduous task, have forged a society that has endured countless hardships and isolation with unwavering resolve. 

We acknowledge the historical ties that bind our two peoples together, and we acknowledge the priceless assistance provided to us in our founding years. But we cannot ignore that realities have shaped our present. The instability that has tightly gripped Erene since the wars of the early 22nd century, the subsequent decay of federal capacity, and the withdrawal of effective governance beyond the Belt of Tears have left Hyperborea in the practice of self-administration for over a decade. The dissolution of the Hyperborean Mandate in 2157 marked a conclusion to an imposed structure that no longer serves its purpose, nor commands respect among our populace.

In years since, we, the citizens of this world- those who were born of this planet and choose Hyperborea as their home, not Erene- have forged ourselves an identity distinct, coherent, and unified as the spirit of freedom. Through democratic processes and referenda across the Six Republics, the people have determined that we are no longer to be regarded as another dependency of Erene, but as a self-determining polity.

[b]Accordingly, we reiterate the following terms to you:
- Hereafter, we recognize ourselves as the Combine of Eirian, a sovereign and independent state.
- All administrative, legal, economic, and military functions are officially transferred to the government, which will solely conduct them with the will of the people.
- Previous structures of the Federation-appointed governance are dissolved, and shall not be reinstated henceforth.
-  The Combine of Eirian remains open to diplomatic normalization, trade agreements, transit rights, and other related cooperative frameworks with the Federation based on parity and mutual respect.
- No return to subordinate colonial status shall be considered; any attempt to forcefully subjugate the Combine will be met with hostilities.[/b]

This communique is not an indictment of the Federation, nor is it an act of hostility. It is the natural culmination of circumstances set in motion by history, born of complete necessity, dignity, and maturation of a new people. We express our most earnest hope that relations between our government may proceed peacefully, and under recognition of this reality. Under this expression, we would further like to express our disapproval of the High Council's decision to mandate a cessation of the food trade beyond the belt of tears. We hope this communique will allow the High Council to reconsider its decision and grant an exemption to the Combine in this regard.

The Combine extends its hand not as a subordinate, but as a neighbor.[/sub]

Long Live the Combine, Long Live the Six Republics,

[b]AURIN BRENN [/b]
Interim Speaker of the Provisional Congress
Republic of Eirian, Hyperborea

[b]DR. SEONS MANCAID[/b]
Minister of Interplanetary Affairs

[b]ADM. RHISED MIXTA[/b]
Commander of the Eirian Settlement Defense Force[/list] 

([nation]Erene Federation[/nation)
